name: Jarvanam
description: Jarvanam was a planet located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Astal sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of the Baradis School of Technology, a covert criminal training organization and member of the Tenloss Syndicate.
lead_paragraphs: Jarvanam was a planet located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Astal sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of the Baradis School of Technology, a covert criminal training organization and member of the Tenloss Syndicate.
